title: Package customizations read does not list a tab arrangement: an extension's relatedLists (and fieldGroups) arrangement has no entry in GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Measured by the #36499 dev (PR #36624). Not claimed. Related: #36499 (its acceptance line moves here), #36505 (same gap for `fieldGroups`).

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:spec` (response schema), with the runtime producer riding along (`domain:server`)

## What happens

`GET /api/v1/packages/<package>/customizations` answers through the strict `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/`), whose per-kind contribution entries cover an extension's fields, validations and indexes only. An object extension that carries a `relatedLists` arrangement (record tab order, titles, hidden entries; #36499 writes it into the paired `.custom` package) has no place in that answer, so the customization is invisible on the package's customizations read. It can be read back through `GET /meta/object_extension/<object>?package=<package>.custom`. `fieldGroups` arrangements (#36505) have the same gap.

## Ask

Widen the customizations answer with an arrangement entry for an extension's `relatedLists` and `fieldGroups`, produced by the runtime from the stored extension, so an admin who lists a package's customizations sees a tab or group arrangement they made. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

## Acceptance (moved from #36499)

HotCRM 「线索」 record page: reorder and hide a tab, save; `GET /api/v1/packages/<HotCRM package>/customizations` lists that arrangement; the original package is unchanged.
